mapper.sql: id, actor_identity_id AS actor, idempotency_key AS key, display_name AS displayName, tenant_expires_at AS tenantExpiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, replay_until AS replayUntil, response_body::TEXT AS responseBody
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_creation_recovery(actor_identity_id, idempotency_key, display_name, tenant_expires_at, created_at, replay_until) VALUES (#{actor}, #{key}, #{displayName}, #{tenantExpiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{replayUntil}) ON CONFLICT (actor_identity_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tenant_creation_recovery WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT FROM tenant_creation_recovery WHERE actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_creation_recovery SET response_body = CAST(#{responseBody} AS JSONB), replay_until = #{replayUntil} WHERE id = #{id} AND actor_identity_id = #{actor} AND response_body IS NULL
